subject: Security posture & VPC deployment — discovery / SOC 2, GDPR, vendor SQ follow-up
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@finhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Security posture & VPC deployment — discovery

Hi Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking time on the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks from our side so we can triage internally: 

- FinHealth is evaluating Redwood for a customer-facing analytics feature that will process ePHI (limited patient identifiers) and general financial data.
- Our security/compliance team needs: SOC 2 report (last 12 months), any GDPR/HIPAA posture docs, and answers to our vendor security questionnaire.
- We also want to understand private deployment options: VPC, on-prem, and an air-gapped/on-premise diagram showing network isolation and data flow (ingress/egress).

Questions from our side (high-level):
1) Do you have a BAA / HIPAA support program and references for handling ePHI?
2) What KMS/HSM integrations do you support for customer-managed keys?
3) For Private deployments, can you provide a standard deployment diagram and an estimate of the ops lift for an air-gapped install?

Next steps we discussed on the call:
- Redwood to share SOC 2 attestation and a VPC/on-prem deployment diagram.
- Initiate vendor security questionnaire — we can share the XLSX and mark priority fields.
- Schedule a follow-up technical session with your infra/ops engineer and our security lead.

Proposed follow-up: Thursday (2026-11-25) 10:00 AM PT — does that work for you?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Smith
Director, IT Security
FinHealth Analytics
 jordan.smith@finhealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security posture & VPC deployment — discovery

Jordan — thanks for the clear notes and for the call this morning. Quick recap on our side and what we'll send over by EOD tomorrow: 

Recap / immediate answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant. I will attach our most recent attestation and the control mapping document. (See attachments list below.)
- HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA workloads; we can provide a standard BAA and discuss any tailored language if needed.
- KMS/HSM: We support AWS KMS CMKs, GCP KMS, and integrations with customer HSM via KMIP in Private deployments. I'll include a short note on supported key rotation patterns.
- Private / VPC / On-prem: We'll attach a standard VPC deployment diagram and a separate air-gapped deployment overview that shows network isolation points and required ops steps.

Owners and next steps:
- Marissa will own the SOC 2 / legal artifacts and the vendor SQ comments.
- Monica will own the architecture diagram and ops notes for on-prem/air-gapped installs.
- I will schedule the follow-up technical session for Thursday 11/25 at 10am PT (pending your confirmation).

Attachments (we'll attach as stubs in this thread):
- SOC2_report_2025.pdf (attestation)
- network_diagram_vpc.png (VPC + air-gap notes)
- vendor_sq_finhealth.xlsx (template answers / questions)

If any of these items should go to a different contact at FinHealth, let me know and I'll loop them in.

Thanks again — we'll follow up with the files and a calendar invite.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:55:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security posture & VPC deployment — discovery

Jordan — following up with the artifacts Marcus mentioned. Attached are the initial files; we redacted any customer-specific notes from the SOC 2 report for confidentiality.

Attachments: 
- SOC2_report_2025.pdf (redacted attestation, control summary)
- vendor_sq_finhealth.xlsx (our suggested answers in blue; please flag anything you want us to expand)
- network_diagram_vpc.png (VPC + air-gapped optional layer)

A couple of clarifications:
- BAA: We have a standard BAA. If you expect to store/process ePHI at scale, we should get your legal team and ours on a short call to confirm terms.
- Data residency / GDPR: For hosted Redwood we support region controls; we can discuss dedicated / private hosting for stricter residency requirements.
- Air-gapped install: Our on-prem package supports air-gapped installs; typical ops effort includes an initial onsite setup (or remote via approved VPN), a one-time image load, and manual certificate/key injection for HSM. Lead time is usually 4-6 weeks depending on procurement and approvals.

I've also pre-filled the vendor SQ for the high-priority items you mentioned. Marcus / Monica are standing by for the technical deep-dive on Thursday 11/25 10:00 AM PT. If that time doesn't work, propose alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@finhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, CTO FinHealth <cto@finhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security posture & VPC deployment — discovery

Thanks Marcus / Marissa — received the files and the pre-filled SQ. A few quick notes from our security and infra leads: 

- We will need a BAA in place due to ePHI; please send your standard BAA and any notes on modifications your legal team has seen in similar customers.
- For our production rollout we expect to run in a private VPC initially, with a long-term plan for an air-gapped on-prem instance for certain regulated customers. The network diagram looks good; can Monica share the ops checklist (ports, certificate steps, firewall rules) as a short one-pager?
- KMS/HSM: we use AWS KMS CMKs across our stack but are evaluating an HSM for higher assurance. Please include any KMIP/HSM integration notes.

Let's keep Thursday 11/25 10:00 AM PT for the technical session — I've added our CTO to the invite. If you can send the calendar invite and a short agenda (30 minutes), we'll confirm attendees.

Deal note: FH-2026-0427 — initial POC budget approved; security artifacts / BAA + deployment checklist are blockers for pilot kickoff.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Jordan
Director, IT Security
FinHealth Analytics
jordan.smith@finhealth.com
